briefdescription.para: This function is used to obtain information about the current state of a device.

detaileddescription.para: The caller must pass a pointer to an XPm_DeviceStatus structure, which must be pre-allocated by the caller.

listitem.para:
Status - The current power state of the device
For CPU nodes:
0 : if CPU is powered down,
1 : if CPU is active (powered up),
8 : if CPU is suspending (powered up)
For power islands and power domains:
0 : if island is powered down,
2 : if island is powered up
For slaves:
0 : if slave is powered down,
1 : if slave is powered up,
9 : if slave is in retention
Requirement - Requirements placed on the device by the caller

Usage
0 : node is not used by any PU,
1 : node is used by caller exclusively,
2 : node is used by other PU(s) only,
3 : node is used by caller and by other PU(s)

memberdef.name: XPm_RequestWakeUp

briefdescription.para: This function can be used by a subsystem to start-up and wake-up a child subsystem.

detaileddescription.para: If the target subsystem has been loaded and is ready to run, it will start running. If the target subsystem is suspended, it will resume.

parameterdescription.para:
Specifies whether to set the start address.
0 : do not set start address
1 : set start address
Address from which to resume when woken up.

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS if successful else XST_FAILURE or an error code or a reason code
This function does not block. A successful return code means that the request has been received.

inbodydescription.para: PSM is required to be up when any application processor is running. In case of default subsystem, PSM is part of pre-alloc. So PSM might be powered down during force power down of subsystem. Currently there is no user option to force power down default subsystem because every processor is part of default subsystem and we don't allow force power down of own subsystem. However, if we want to use XPmSubsystem_ForcePwrDwn() from other cases (e.g. subsystem restart) then PSM power down will happen. So skip PSM power down from XPmSubsystem_ForcePwrDwn().
